mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines over 3 months and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a contracting economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a contracting economy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 growth < 0% and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by less than 0.5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7%, it signals weak consumer demand coupled with high unemployment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: weak consumer demand with high unemployment
failure_condition: If RSAFS growth < 0.5% MoM and UNRATE > 7% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances.
